removability.rationale: Deleting the feature is one directory plus one section in one page, with only a small `hidden` prop left dangling on the shared card component.

changeability.rationale: Most data fixes land in one obvious place, but the sprite rule is duplicated with a prop-override trap (fixing PokemonCard alone misses the home page), and small helpers are re-implemented inline in two spots.

evidence: app/src/pages/index.astro:188 — client `createCard` hand-builds the card DOM with the component's hardcoded class names, silently coupled to PokemonCard.astro's markup
app/src/pages/index.astro:53 — server data crosses to the client only through an explicit JSON payload (good seam)
app/src/components/PokemonCard.astro:6-14 — narrow, documented props; no imports of page internals

coupling.rationale: Components and pages sit on narrow seams (props, pokeapi helpers, a JSON payload), but the client-side card re-implementation is coupled by convention to the component's markup, and page frontmatter digs into untyped raw API resources.

evidence: app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:246 — `mapPokemonToSpecies` absorbs the Pokémon-vs-species variation and is reused by moves, abilities and types pages
app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:206-260 — typed interfaces (MoveDetailRow, MoveMethodGroup, PokemonMovesData) around real variation

app/src/pages/moves/[name].astro:20-38 — the fetch/isNotFound/404-status boilerplate is copy-pasted, identically, in abilities/[name].astro:19-36, types/[name].astro:19-36 and pokemon/[name].astro:19-42
app/src/pages/index.astro:31 and index.astro:228 — the home listing exists as two parallel implementations (server JSX and client DOM) rather than one shared renderer
abstraction_design.rationale: The data layer is a genuine, stretchable seam, but per-page fetch/404 boilerplate is copy-pasted four times, the home list has no shared renderer, and the card is accumulating boolean flags.

findings.issue: The home listing is implemented twice: server frontmatter renders cards and pagination, then a ~170-line client script re-implements filtering, pagination, URL building, `humanize` and the card markup (createCard, line 188) with hardcoded class names that must be kept in sync with PokemonCard.astro by hand.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/sort/pagination, URL-serialization and card-template logic into a shared module and `import` it from both the frontmatter and the bundled `<script>` (Astro processes client scripts and supports imports); or render card HTML as strings from one source of truth.

findings.issue: Sprite URL construction is duplicated: PokemonCard.astro:16 derives it as a fallback, while index.astro precomputes an explicit `sprite` prop that silently overrides it — a fix in the component will not reach the home page.
findings.suggestion: Drop the `sprite` prop and precomputation entirely and let PokemonCard own the URL derivation; pass only `id`.

findings.issue: The fetch-resource / isNotFound / `Astro.response.status = 404` boilerplate is copy-pasted identically in all four `[name].astro` pages (also abilities:19-36, types:19-36, pokemon:19-42).
findings.suggestion: Add a `loadResource(kind, name)` helper in app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts that returns `{ data, notFound }` and call it from each page.

findings.issue: `humanize` is re-implemented in the client script even though it already exists at app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:61; the two copies must stay in sync for search results to match the server.
findings.suggestion: Move `humanize` (and the filter predicate) to a module the client script can import.

findings.issue: Re-implements the `idFromUrl` regex inline instead of using the exported helper at app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts:58.

The generic card component bakes in ability-specific semantics (`hidden` prop rendering 'Hidden ability'), leaving dead code once the ability feature is removed and making the card a flag magnet (showTypes, hidden, sprite).
findings.suggestion: Use a `<slot name="badge" />` for page-specific extras instead of per-feature props.

findings.issue: Byte-identical duplicate of app/src/pages/[...path].astro; with `output: 'server'` both render the same NotFoundContent for unmatched routes, so one is redundant.
findings.suggestion: Keep the catch-all only, or make 404.astro the single implementation and have the catch-all import it.

summary: A tidy, idiomatic Astro 7 SSR app whose data layer is a real, reusable seam and whose components are small and prop-driven. Editability is dragged down by the home page's parallel client-side re-implementation of the listing and the sprite-URL duplication with a prop that overrides the component's own logic. Per-page copy-pasted fetch/404 boilerplate means every new resource page repeats the same 20 lines.
